purpose: one record per SHADOW boundary run, so the skill measures its own effect instead of presuming it: known-class recurrence per wave must trend to zero as classes gate, and a curve that has not bent after three post-admission waves is itself a finding about the architecture.
subject_kinds: the subject field names the station the run served, and its vocabulary is the target ids of domain/observation-topology.json - never a second list here. A record naming a station that file does not carry reds as OBSERVATION_TARGET_UNGROUNDED, and the declining curve is sliceable by station because of this one field.
append_only: records are appended by scripts/shadow_driver.py --append-record and never rewritten. What one file state can carry is checked: scripts/validate_red_team.py requires every run_id to be the producer's ISO-8601 instant and to not go backwards, so a typed label or a record inserted before an existing one reds. The rest of append-only is carried by git history and branch protection, not by this sentence.
persisted_report: domain/persisted-reports/<wave>.json holds the producer's own report object, written by --save-report at the pass. --from-report derives the row from one of those through the same ledger_record(), so a record no longer has to be appended before the wave lands - which it did have to be, because landing mutates the bundle the producer would otherwise have to re-measure (ed3c/skill-concerns#158; #131's acceptance clause is what detects that). run_id is still the instant OF THE PASS, carried in the artifact. The artifact is committed at the boundary and git history is what says when it appeared; the hand-authored-report-artifact row of domain/residual-sensor-register.json is where the rest of that is registered.
unpersistable: a pass whose report was never persisted, and whose bundle has since landed, cannot produce a record at all. Those runs are listed with their reason in domain/unpersistable-runs.json rather than dropped, and they are never typed in: the numbers are exactly what was lost.
